howto.name: Upload a MOV file
howto.text: Drop a .mov file up to 500 MB.

howto.name: PrivaTools re-encodes via FFmpeg
howto.text: The video is re-encoded as VP9 at about 1 Mbit/s with Opus audio, well below the bitrate of a typical phone or camera MOV, and it plays without QuickTime.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Run the conversion. VP9 WebM is the right output for the open web: usually much smaller than a camera MOV, and playable without QuickTime.

faq.a: WebM (VP9/Opus) is the open format for fast-loading HTML5 video and is well-supported in browsers. MOV→WebM always re-encodes because the codecs differ.
Usually yes. The video is encoded at about 1 Mbit/s, far below the bitrate of most phone and camera MOVs, so the file shrinks a lot; a MOV that is already small may not.
Yes — local FFmpeg on the PrivaTools backend; files removed after the response.
